descriptive: Exposure to the test chemical resulted in dose-related changes in clinical chemistry measurements. Reliable BMD values were calculated for 2 endpoints.

In male animals, the most sensitive endpoint was ALT (clinical chemistry; BMD = 18.5 mg/kg, BMDL = 12.0 mg/kg); with 2 reliable BMD estimates overall (BMDs ranged from 18.5 to 55.0 mg/kg). In female animals, no apical endpoints showed dose-related changes.
